recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-31485 unless a future ballot deliberately revisits the scheduling model wording.
issue_request: FHIR-31485 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration change request for FHIR-core Slot. It asked that Slot.serviceType stop using the undefined phrase availability resource and its final resolution said the definition should instead say the Slot value overrides the value provided on the Schedule resource.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 938a96e1cdd538baa9f7d6a4e5d7126edc42aafc on 2021-05-27, changing source/slot/structuredefinition-Slot.xml from availability resource to Schedule resource in Slot.serviceType and changing the nearby iCal mapping from Availability to Schedule. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key audit commit for FHIR-31485 existed on the combined branch before this reconciliation.
additional_context: Slot is active in the current build because source/fhir.ini lists Slot in the active resources section and marks it approved. PA May 2021 minutes record the same persuasive 7-0-0 disposition. A 2017 Zulip thread confirms the original ambiguity, and later FHIR-22687 work changed Slot.serviceType to CodeableReference without reintroducing the old wording.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. The current authoritative Slot StructureDefinition already says Schedule resource in both the Slot.serviceType short and definition, and a source-wide search found no remaining availability resource phrase.

related_jiras.note: Later same-element work changed Slot.serviceType to CodeableReference but retained the corrected Schedule wording, so it does not alter the FHIR-31485 no-change decision.
